_about: The entire Restless menu. menu.html renders whatever is in here — editing a price is a one-line change in this file. Transcribed from photographs of the printed menu, September 2026.

_editing.menus: Three top-level menus become the tabs on the menu page.
_editing.section: id, name, optional note, optional addons, then either `items` or `groups` (groups are the Veggie/Meat splits the printed menu uses).
_editing.item: name (required), description (optional), price (number in EGP, or null to hide it), badge (optional, e.g. "new" for the flash the printed menu uses).

notice: All prices are subject to 12% service charge and value added tax.
